component.name: EnderGram
component.summary: Fast, low-memory Telegram desktop client for Linux

description.p: EnderGram is a Telegram-compatible desktop client for Linux with ghost mode, saved message history, message filters, built-in translation, streamer mode and deep customisation.
It ships a native shell launcher with a low-memory profile (about 250 MB RSS), XWayland raster rendering by default and optional GPU acceleration, plus the Noir and Frost themes.
First public release: low-memory launcher, Noir and Frost themes, custom chat wallpaper, ghost mode, filters, translation and streamer mode.
